utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m at the garage and ready to sort—just point me to the tools and boxes that need organizing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — start with the tools on the left shelf and the labeled boxes by the workbench. I’m keeping the running list, so let me know what’s missing or out of place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll sort the left shelf tools and the boxes by the workbench, and I’ll tell you if I spot anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll start with the community center, then check the bulletin board by the café and mark what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect—I’m heading by later to see if they still need another hand. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess—I'll note those two spots as checked and wait for your update on anything still open.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the repair drive plan once it’s set? I’m not calling it settled until I see the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the repair drive plan once it’s set and circle back with the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — I’ll wait for the confirmed details before I call it settled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing together the latest, but I’ll pass along anything I hear about what they need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’m still planning to stop by after errands with a couple tools, and I can see whether they need an extra hour of coverage too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira—that’d be a big help. I’m still waiting on the latest, but I’ll let you know right away if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’d really appreciate that. I’m still double-checking the route, timing, and whether the tools and spare parts are all loaded before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Pia — I’m a little fuzzy, but I can help check the tools and parts or whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That still works for me — I’ll keep the 3:30 to 5:00 pickup window in mind. Just let me know if you need me to line anything up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’ll let you know if anything else needs lining up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send me a note if the timing shifts, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got the tools, and I’ll do one last check on the route and supplies before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Gus — thanks for checking that. I’m ready to help with whatever’s left and can pitch in once you’ve got the route set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — I’ll finish the route check and then we can load up the tools together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Jules — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the urgent list first. If you’ve got any new repairs or volunteers, send them my way and I’ll add them in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll pass along any new repairs or volunteers I hear about. I’ll also keep an eye out for anyone who can help with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — bikes and small appliances are perfect additions, and I’ll put them on the urgent list. If anyone can help sort tools or greet folks on Sunday, send them my way too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got the urgent repairs list ready, Leo — I’ll send it over now so you can help sort them first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — send it over and I’ll sort the urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo — I’ll send the list now and keep you posted on anything urgent that comes up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send it over as soon as I’ve got the route and loadout confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, just keep me posted and I’ll pitch in wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which spots still need coverage?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure yet — just send me the spots that still need coverage, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — which spot should I send first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the date, time, and drop-off spot now, then I’ll verify the tools and spare parts we already have.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’m still bringing the tools this afternoon, and I can help carry anything over too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll confirm the details now and let you know if anything’s missing before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, I’m here now—what still needs sorting at the garage, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — can you confirm you’ve still got your tools with you? If so, I’ll tell you what to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I’ve got my tools with me—just tell me what to tackle first at the garage.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word to a few neighbors right away and bring the tools list over too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, thanks — I’ll stop by after errands with a couple tools and check the main table too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks — I’ll keep rounding up neighbors and make sure the garage table has the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still good — I’ll bring the tools by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — which drop-off spot should I use, and does the south block still need coverage?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure I caught the latest, sorry — the community center and the bulletin board by the café sounded right. And yes, I think the south block could still use coverage.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I’d feel better if we double-check the route and the supplies before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll double-check the supplies list and resend any updates before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll double-check the route, and then we should be set once the supplies are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Leo—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — we’re prioritizing the biggest urgent repairs first, then any safety issues. Send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — that helps. I’ll look over the list and send what I can once I’ve got my head straight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — let’s go over the route and do one last check on the supplies before we roll out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll do one last check on the supplies and route, and we’re set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Rosa — I’ll grab the tools and spare parts, then we can head out together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you help sort donations by the garage? We still need a hand with the tools and boxes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help sort the tools and boxes by the garage. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — start with the boxes near the garage door, and I’ll sort the tools with you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and see who can bring tools or help with bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that helps a lot. I’ll send along the repair details and the urgent repairs list soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — send it over when you can, and I’ll keep an eye out for folks who can help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just keep me posted on what’s still needed, and I’ll bring by anything useful I spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do — I’m checking what’s still needed now, and I’ll keep you posted on anything useful to bring by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out and swing by if I find anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely, Nell — I’m in for the repair drive. Just send me the time and what you’d like me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’m still waiting on the latest update, but I’ll send the time and what’s needed as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Nell — I’ll keep my gloves and flashlight ready and wait for your update.
